_comment: Where the Dictionary's concepts come from (config/dictionary). Since 2026-10-10 they are not listed here: a concept is an entry on the Demo Dictionary Concepts list, filed by a curator, so adding one is a publish, not a deploy. The five this file used to list (GitHub Accounts, Food and Drink Places, Divine Videos, V4V Songs, Books) were filed by scripts/bootstrap-dictionary-concepts.sh; their notes are in this file's git history.
_conceptList: Demo Dictionary Concepts, Vinney's list (2026-10-10). An entry: ['a', <concept coordinate>] required, ['name', …] recommended, ['removed', …] takes it out. Only curators' entries count; the latest per entry wins. A bridge: the House's own copies are meant to replace it.
_curatorTag: Dictionary Concept Curator, Vinney's tag (2026-10-10). The curators are the people the house (the server's NIP-05 `_`, discovered, never configured) has tagged with it, plus the list's own author. The house applies it in the Brainstorm UI like any other person tag; polarity -1 disputes it.
_roles: Concepts the app relies on, kept out of the Dictionary's view and search: infrastructure, not demos. PROVISIONAL (2026-10-01) url-templates: Vinney's canonical URL Templates list (self-b); its items carry ['url-template', <RFC 6570 level-1 template>] and a name, and a header pins one by event id with ['link', <id>, <relay>, <placeholder>, <field>, …] (lib/linkTemplates). The link picker reads its governing list for the reader: their copy, their Assistant's, else this one. Its items still render through it.
_pending: URLs — no kind-39998 URLs concept exists on any relay (searched dcosl, tags.brainstorm.world, staging, tapestry; 2026-10-01). Decision 2026-10-01: GitHub Accounts first, URLs once someone authors it. Its coordinate is permanent once copies point at it, so choose the author first.
